headline: Is something blocking my money, or did I just leave it too late?
note:
FRAME: money — the strictest guard on the funnel. No amount, no date, no source, no financial advice, never blames her, never 'too late', never presumes she is broke.

🔴 Beat 4 says the money has not LANDED or not STAYED — never that she has none. Her own ad asserts the block, so restating it is her premise, not our claim.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE. The six beats never need it; naming an inheritance is the shortest path to the authorship ban.

FINDING: 'not too late, and a block moves' — carried by beat 5b, 'what holds it can move'.

🔴 The ad hands her the self-blame outright. Beat 3 declines it on all three cards, in three different shapes (pre-flight step 3). ⛔ 'it's too late' is banned outright — the read never says the words in either direction.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing told the three apart, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. Four things on it, and the table stands in the open.
You asked if something is blocking your money, or if the moment has gone. What catches me is that all four are within reach.
And yet it hasn't landed. And you've offered me the harsher half yourself.
Something stands between you and it, close in and squarely in the way. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what this is…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and yours was held by one rope.
Look at the rope. It's tied at one ankle, and that's all.
You asked if something is blocking your money, or if the moment has gone. One rope can hold all of that.
Still, it hasn't come through. And you're asking me to choose between the two.
Whatever it is comes in right as the money would. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed through, and yours was the only card in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. Gold, and not a cloud in sight.
You asked if something is blocking your money, or if the moment has gone. That day is bright, and his foot is up.
But it hasn't landed. And you're the one asking whether it's gone past you.
Whatever holds this holds it firmly, and nothing in it moves. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding this…
